description: Expected verification outcomes for the curated demo corpus and demo brief. docs/TESTING.md requires these to pass before demo day. Each entry names the citation as it appears in server/db/seed/demo-brief.ts and the status the engine must return for it.

cases.claimedCaseTitle: Lalit Kumar Jain v. Union of India & Ors.
cases.notes: Correctly cited, correctly attributed to paragraph 125, and quoted verbatim from the indexed paragraph. Every deterministic check passes.

cases.claimedCaseTitle: Dr. Vishnu Kumar Agarwal v. Piramal Enterprises Ltd.
cases.notes: Tribunal case number resolves exactly; the proposition the brief draws from it is an accurate statement of the indexed holding at paragraph 37.

cases.claimedCaseTitle: State Bank of India v. V. Ramakrishnan & Anr.
cases.notes: The authority exists and the title resolves by fuzzy match, but the brief cites it as (2019) 17 SCC 394. The indexed record is (2018) 17 SCC 394, decided 14 August 2018.

cases.claimedCaseTitle: Committee of Creditors of Essar Steel India Ltd. v. Satish Kumar Gupta & Ors.
cases.notes: Citation and metadata are correct — note that the reporter volume year (2020) legitimately differs from the decision year (2019) and must not be flagged. The quotation attributed to paragraph 67 does not appear in the indexed text of that paragraph.

cases.claimedCaseTitle: Ghanashyam Mishra & Sons Pvt. Ltd. v. Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Co. Ltd.
cases.notes: The authority is correctly cited, but the brief attributes to it a proposition about a creditor forfeiting its right to enforce a guarantee, which the indexed paragraphs do not bear out.

cases.claimedCaseTitle: Pooja Ramesh Singh v. State Bank of India & Anr.
cases.notes: No record in the connected sources carries this citation or a comparable title. Per LEGAL_DATA_RULES.md the result must be worded as a coverage finding about the connected sources, never as a finding that the authority is fabricated.
